scripts.test: npm run test:docs && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:packages && node --import tsx --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts apps/coordinator/test/*.test.ts apps/workbench/test/*.test.ts
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/core packages/adapter-postgres apps/coordinator apps/cli
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @evoloop/workbench
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @evoloop/workbench
